payload.blocks: The 7th cargo failure (authoring_equivalence) of plan 261124-0004-heads-operate-without-owner, and the plan's done status.
payload.headline: Phase 7: swap the wrong config fixture for repo-differences.v1.json so the last cargo failure can be fixed

parts.cause: Answer q-xcuwpxa4kn named the wrong fixture. The recorded list is the standard-only array in packages/config/contracts/fixtures/repo-differences.v1.json (read at authoring_equivalence.rs:27), not authoring-source.config.json. That file is outside the plan footprint, so no unit may write it.

options.cost: One planner edit and one small unit, about 15 minutes.
options.does: A planner replaces packages/config/contracts/fixtures/authoring-source.config.json with packages/config/contracts/fixtures/repo-differences.v1.json in the plan footprint; the lead runs one unit adding ["release"] to its standard-only list, reviews and lands it.
options.gain: All 7 of this plan's cargo failures are fixed by the plan that caused them; acceptance criterion 2 can be met.
options.harm: One more footprint edit; the net footprint size is unchanged.
options.label: Swap the fixture path in the footprint

options.does: Phase 7 records authoring_equivalence as known; a new backlog item fixes it.
options.harm: Main stays red on one test this plan caused; acceptance criterion 2 is not met.
options.label: Leave it to a backlog item

parts.recommendation: Swap the fixture path: it is the file the owner meant to allow in q-xcuwpxa4kn, and the change is one array entry.

scope.allows: Replacing authoring-source.config.json with repo-differences.v1.json in the plan footprint, and one unit that adds ["release"] to its standard-only list.
scope.forbids: Any other footprint change; touching the npm failures or the holder-lock test.

parts.what: The fix unit for this plan's 7 stale cargo failures passed 6 of 7 (reviewed, landing now). authoring_equivalence still fails at packages/config/rust/tests/authoring_equivalence.rs:181: the standard now has release, but the recorded standard-only list lacks it.
